_comment: The sca-xpi-in-archive submission with one thing changed: its package.json declares a dependency and no lock file is committed. The archive still holds every byte the XPI ships, so sca-xpi-fully-included-in-archive rejects it and the review stops there, before sca-lock-file-missing could report the missing lock. An archive holding the built XPI ends the review whatever its build looks like.
